n757c8e3e38c.s: Which of the following explains why India's eastern coast has relatively fewer ports?
o: Deep water close to the shore
Shallow continental shelf and frequent cyclones
Deep water along its whole length
n757c8e3e38c.x: The east coast's shallow continental shelf and cyclones explain its fewer ports; deep water close to the shore is a feature of the west coast.

nc6918d18427.s: In the LPPI 2024–25, which port led the liquid bulk category?
nc6918d18427.x: Sikka led liquid bulk; Paradip led dry bulk and Mundra led container cargo.

nworld-geography-25-3.s:
Consider the following statements about Rotterdam:
1. It is the largest port in Europe.
2. It lies at the mouth of the Rhine–Meuse delta, with a vast European hinterland.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
nworld-geography-25-3.x: Both are true: Rotterdam sits on the Rhine–Meuse delta, whose river, rail and road links to Europe's industrial heart make it the continent's largest port.

nefae8be0d15.s: The Amended BharatNet arrangement for Andhra Pradesh (February 2026) provides last-mile connectivity to how many villages?
nefae8be0d15.x: The Memorandum of Cooperation covers 3,942 villages, with broadband to every household within 18 months.

n2e879f2b4e0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about 5G Standalone (SA)?
n2e879f2b4e0.x: 5G SA is independent of a 4G core; it is pure 5G with lower latency and network slicing.

nphysics-18-51.s: Which of the following pairs related to the endoscope is correctly matched?
o: Illuminating fibre bundle – Carries the image back
Image fibre bundle – Lights up the body cavity
nphysics-18-51.x: An endoscope works on total internal reflection in optical fibre bundles: one bundle illuminates the cavity and another carries the image back.

nap-geography-26-7.s:
Consider the following statements about Visakhapatnam Port Authority:
1. It is located in Visakhapatnam district.
2. It is an all-weather, deep-water port.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
nap-geography-26-7.x: Both are true: the port is in Visakhapatnam district and is an all-weather, deep-water port.

n293e4e75bf1.s: Which of the following is identified as a challenge to logistics and port development in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Absence of dedicated freight rail to clusters
n293e4e75bf1.x: The stated challenges include high logistics costs, no dedicated freight rail to clusters, water-short inland nodes, CBI-stalled ports and land-acquisition delays.

n584a01a89f9.s: Gannavaram is the existing location of which airport?
n584a01a89f9.x: Gannavaram is the site of the existing Vijayawada Airport, so it is not a proposed greenfield airport location.

nedfd826d070.s: Which of the following is one of the five pillars of the Sagarmala programme?
nedfd826d070.x: Coastal community development is a Sagarmala pillar; dedicated freight corridors are a railway programme, not a pillar.

new.s: How many National Waterways were declared by the National Waterways Act, 2016?
new.x: The National Waterways Act 2016 declared 111 National Waterways.

new.s: National Waterway-1 (Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly) runs between:
new.x: NW-1 runs Haldia-Prayagraj (1,620 km); Dhubri-Sadiya is NW-2 and Kollam-Kottapuram is NW-3.

new.s: Jogighopa and Tezpur are terminals on which National Waterway?
new.x: NW-2 on the Brahmaputra (Dhubri-Sadiya) has terminals at Dhubri, Jogighopa, Tezpur, Dibrugarh and Sadiya.

new.s: The Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI), set up in 1986, has its headquarters at:
new.x: IWAI was set up in 1986 with its headquarters at Noida.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about India's coasts:
1. Deep water close to the shore is found on the west coast.
2. East coast ports are mostly artificial.
3. The west coast has sheltered natural harbours.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are true: the west has deep water near shore and sheltered natural harbours, while the east has mostly artificial ports.

new.s: Which major port is India's corporatised port?
new.x: Kamarajar (Ennore) is the corporatised major port and India's first corporatised port.

new.s: Which is listed as India's oldest artificial port?
new.x: Chennai is the oldest of the artificial ports of the east coast.

new.s: Deendayal (Kandla) port is classified as a:
new.x: Deendayal (Kandla) is a tidal port; Kolkata-Haldia is riverine and Visakhapatnam landlocked.

new.s: Mormugao major port is in which State?
new.x: Mormugao is Goa's major port; New Mangalore is in Karnataka and Kochi in Kerala.

new.s: India's largest container port is:
new.x: JNPA is India's largest container port; Mundra only leads the LPPI container ranking.

new.s: The world's first fully solar-powered airport is:
new.x: Cochin International Airport (CIAL) is the world's first fully solar-powered airport.

new.s: India's busiest airport, with about 78.1 million passengers in 2025, is:
new.x: Delhi IGI is the busiest (about 78.1 million passengers, 11th in the world); Mumbai is second.

new.s: India's operational airports rose from 74 in 2014 to about how many in 2025?
new.x: Operational airports grew from 74 in 2014 to 164 in 2025.

new.s: The National Maritime Heritage Complex is being built by MoPSW as:
new.x: MoPSW is building the National Maritime Heritage Complex as Asia's largest maritime heritage museum.

new.s: The Ministry of Shipping was renamed the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways in:
new.x: The ministry was renamed MoPSW in 2020.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh seeks central support for a mega shipbuilding cluster at:
new.x: AP has sought central support for a mega shipbuilding cluster at Dugarajapatnam.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of world port and country is correctly matched?
new.x: Yokohama is Japan's busiest port; Busan is South Korea's, Antwerp-Bruges is in Belgium and Maracaibo in Venezuela.

new.s: The first fully operational INSAT satellite was:
new.x: INSAT-1B (1983) was the first fully operational INSAT satellite.

new.s: The broadband satellite GSAT-N2 (GSAT-20) was launched in November 2024 on:
new.x: GSAT-N2 (GSAT-20) was launched by a SpaceX Falcon 9 in November 2024.

new.s: The Kochi–Lakshadweep (KLI) submarine cable was inaugurated in:
new.x: KLI was inaugurated in January 2024; CANI (Chennai-Andaman and Nicobar) in August 2020.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about mass media in India?
o: Doordarshan began on 15 September 1959 in Delhi
Anna FM (2004) was India's first community radio
All India Radio was named Akashvani in 1936
Community radio is licensed by MIB
new.x: AIR got its name in 1936 but became Akashvani in 1957, not 1936.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's Real Time Governance Society (RTGS) was formed in:
new.x: RTGS was formed in 2017 for data-driven e-governance under the CMO.

new.s: In a PIN code, a first digit of 9 denotes the:
new.x: The first digit is the zone, and 9 stands for the Army Postal Service.

new.s: Appeals against the decisions of TRAI are heard by:
new.x: TDSAT, created by the 2000 amendment of the TRAI Act, hears disputes and appeals against TRAI.

new.s: BharatNet was earlier known as:
new.x: BharatNet is the former NOFN (2011), not the NKN.

new.s: How many pillars does the Digital India programme have?
new.x: Digital India (1 July 2015) has 9 pillars, the first being broadband highways.

new.s: Mobile number portability within a telecom circle began in India in:
new.x: MNP within a circle began in 2011; nationwide MNP followed on 3 July 2015.

new.s: How many National Highways run through Andhra Pradesh (2024-25)?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh has 55 National Highways covering 8,744 km (2024-25).

new.s: The NH-544G Economic Corridor connects:
new.x: NH-544G is the Bengaluru-Kadapa-Vijayawada Economic Corridor, due by 2027.

new.s: For which of the following road projects has only a DPR been ordered?
new.x: Only a DPR has been ordered for the Kharagpur-Visakhapatnam-Amaravati expressway; the Narketpally road is completed and NH-544G is due by 2027.

new.s: The length of the Nadikudi–Srikalahasti railway line is:
new.x: The Nadikudi-Srikalahasti line is 308 km, through Guntur, Prakasam, Nellore and Chittoor.

new.s: The Kotipalli–Narasapur railway line runs along the:
new.x: Kotipalli-Narasapur is a new line on the Konaseema coast, in progress in February 2026.

new.s: The Cherlopalli–Rapuru rail tunnel in SPSR Nellore is about how long?
new.x: The tunnel is 6.6 km and was India's longest electrified rail tunnel when opened in 2019.

new.s: PMGSY has covered what share of habitations in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: PMGSY has covered 99.09% of habitations in AP.

new.s: APSRTC was established in:
new.x: APSRTC dates from 1958; APRDC was set up in 1998.

new.s: The Buckingham Canal passes through which lake?
new.x: The Buckingham Canal (about 796 km), the east coast's longest commercial navigation canal, runs through Pulicat Lake.

new.s: The Krishna stretch of National Waterway-4 is:
new.x: NW-4's Krishna stretch is Wazirabad-Prakasam Barrage; Bhadrachalam-Dowleswaram is its Godavari stretch.

new.s: Kakinada Anchorage Port is operated by:
new.x: Kakinada Anchorage is State-run by APMB and handles lighterage and rice exports; Kakinada DWP is the OMST port.

new.s: Krishnapatnam Port was developed under which PPP model?
new.x: Krishnapatnam is a PPP-BOST port (2004); Gangavaram is BOOT and Kakinada DWP is OMST.

new.s: Which company is developing the Machilipatnam greenfield port?
new.x: MEIL is developing Machilipatnam port; Vishwa Samudra is building Mulapeta.

new.s: The AP Logistics Fund is an AIF in which the State sponsor's share is up to:
new.x: The AP Logistics Fund is an Alternative Investment Fund with the State as sponsor up to 20%.

new.s: Tirupati (Renigunta) Airport has been an international airport since:
new.x: Tirupati became an international airport in October 2015.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Bhogapuram airport:
1. It is developed by GMR under PPP-DBFOT.
2. It was inaugurated by the Prime Minister on 1 August 2026.
3. It is in Visakhapatnam district.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: GMR (GVIAL) built it under PPP-DBFOT and the PM inaugurated it on 1 August 2026; it is in Vizianagaram district, not Visakhapatnam.

new.s: The South Coast Railway zone became operational on:
new.x: SCoR, India's 18th zone with HQ at Visakhapatnam, became operational on 1 June 2026.
